category: other: missed button press - fingers at the start button touched the machine face but never the button geom, then gave up
what_happened: Scene: layout 8, black/silver capsule machine (CoffeeMachine102: two round buttons SINGLE/DOUBLE on a round front face), red mug_5 on the upper shelf. Stage 0: first close on air at 98, grasp 114, mug carried to the machine and under the spout by ~260 (at target 260-298). It then kept holding and re-adjusting it on the tray 260-579 (re-close 392; at target again 499-534, 555-1200), released 579 at 0.0179 m (0.0184 m 2 s later), upright; stage 0 complete 670 (median 506, p90 865). Stage 1: 604-648 the closed gripper came at the round face from the front, fingertips right at the lower-left SINGLE button (wrist view), touching the machine 621-640, but no start-button contact registered. At ~656 it backed off and up (672-700 wrist sees the shelf), came over the machine top 860-900 (brief touch 886-889) and from ~950 to 1200 hovered above and to the right of the machine looking down at the mug. No second press attempt.
causal_chain: mug placed well but slowly (579, 0.018 m) -> one press attempt 604-648 at the SINGLE button with closed fingers, contact on the machine face only -> machine never on -> backed off and hovered for the last ~500 steps -> timeout
self_recovery: none effective: one brief return to the machine top at 886-889, no second press of the button.

packet_facts: stage0 complete 670-848, 952-1200 (848 = gripper back near mug)

uncertain_about: Exactly where the fingertips hit (face rim below the button vs. the button edge): the wrist view shows the button between/behind the closed fingertips, but the depth is not visible; the packet only says machine contact without a button contact.
